cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(bcm_external LANGUAGES C CXX ASM)
if(NOT WIN32 OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "The external bridge requires Windows x64.")
endif()
add_subdirectory(vendor/minhook)
add_library(bcm_external SHARED bridge.cpp hooks.cpp tick.S)
target_compile_features(bcm_external PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(bcm_external PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_link_options(bcm_external PRIVATE -static)
target_link_libraries(bcm_external PRIVATE advapi32 ole32 bcrypt minhook)
set_target_properties(bcm_external PROPERTIES PREFIX "" OUTPUT_NAME "bcm-external")
add_executable(test_external_tick test_tick.cpp tick.S)
target_compile_features(test_external_tick PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_link_options(test_external_tick PRIVATE -static)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME external_tick_abi COMMAND test_external_tick)
